CNFComponentFactorization:
∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
    let part := fun (x : ℕ) => φ.filter (fun c =>
      @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ =>
        ∃ d ∈ φ, a ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ b ∈ d.map Prod.fst) x m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _))
    PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ ↔ [] ∉ φ ∧ ∀ x, PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (part x)
MeasuredLiteralMap:
∀ (f : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hf : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) f),
    ∃ collect : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) collect ∧
      ∀ (arg : List Bool) (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause),
        collect (arg,PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = c.flatMap (fun l => f (arg,PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral l))
MeasuredVariableGraph:
∃ graph : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) graph ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, graph (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
        PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.flatMap (fun c => c.flatMap (fun l => c.map (fun m => [(l.1,false),(m.1,true)]))))
MeasuredCNFComponent:
∃ get : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) get ∧
      ∀ (l : PEqualNP.Search.Literal) (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
        get (PEqualNP.Search.encodeLiteral l,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.filter (fun c =>
          @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun x y : ℕ =>
            ∃ d ∈ φ, x ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ y ∈ d.map Prod.fst) l.1 m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _)))
ComponentwiseSAT:
∀ (G D : Language Bool) (hG : G ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hSpec : ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ G → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)),
    let part := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (x : ℕ) => φ.filter (fun c =>
      @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ =>
        ∃ d ∈ φ, a ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ b ∈ d.map Prod.fst) x m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _))
    {s : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = s ∧
      (∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (part φ l.1) ∈ G) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactComponentwiseHybridSAT:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    let part := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (x : ℕ) => φ.filter (fun c =>
      @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ =>
        ∃ d ∈ φ, a ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ b ∈ d.map Prod.fst) x m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _))
    {s : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = s ∧ (∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c,
      let p := part φ l.1
      (∀ d ∈ p, (d.filter (fun m => m.2)).length ≤ 1) ∨
      (∃ k : ℕ, 6^k ≤ q.eval (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF p).length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
        PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 (p.map (fun d => d.filter (fun m => decide (m.1 ∉ xs)))))) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ComponentwiseHybridSATSearch:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ),
    let part := fun (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (x : ℕ) => φ.filter (fun c =>
      @decide (∃ m ∈ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b : ℕ =>
        ∃ d ∈ φ, a ∈ d.map Prod.fst ∧ b ∈ d.map Prod.fst) x m.1) (Classical.propDecidable _))
    ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c,
        let p := part φ l.1
        (∀ d ∈ p, (d.filter (fun m => m.2)).length ≤ 1) ∨
        (∃ k : ℕ, 6^k ≤ q.eval (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF p).length + 1 ∧ ∃ xs : List ℕ, xs.length ≤ k ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 (p.map (fun d => d.filter (fun m => decide (m.1 ∉ xs)))))) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
